name: 家长祝福
description: The parent-blessing action: one POST that records a once-per-day blessing against a student. Split out of api/modules/platform (P4.3b.5d), which mixed this business action with three payment-infrastructure routes; only the business half moved, because relocating api/services/paymentService.ts into a feature plugin would be migrating infrastructure as if it were a domain.

data._adopted_note: Keeps its legacy name because the row shape is what other readers see: `activity_type` is the literal 'PARENT_BUFF' and `points_awarded` is always 0, so the table is an attendance log rather than a points ledger. Renaming is the P7 namespace migration tracked by guardrail G10. `parent_id` is nullable and this domain never sets it - the blessing is recorded against the student. auth's parent login writes the *same* table with activity_type 'login' through Prisma (api/modules/auth/auth.service.ts), so that module is a cross-owner writer until it migrates.
